name: Jio WD680+ LTE-Advanced Mobile Wi-Fi Hotspot
description:
Item	Router
Router Type	Pocket
Antenna	Conceal Antenna
Speed	300Mbps
Other Features	4G+ Type
Black Color
One SIM Support
Multi-Languages App Support
AC100 - 240V, DC 5 V/1 A Power Supply
Made in China
Description
This Jio WD680 + mobile Wi-Fi hotspot supports a SIM, has a 32GB memory capacity, microSD card slot, USB port interface, and LED indicator. It has a 2100mAh battery that can be used for about 10 hours. Windows XP, Vista, 7, 8, 10, Mac OS, and Linux are all compatible operating systems.
